articles.title: Panicked Trump’s Real Reason for ICE U-Turn Exposed
articles.description: Kylie Cooper/Reuters Donald Trump abruptly reversed his own administration’s decision to prevent ICE agents from performing traffic stops after watching negative coverage of the plans on television, according to a report. The Department of Homeland Security had informed federal immigration officers that there would be a temporary halt to the practice of stopping people in their vehicles after ICE agents shot and killed two unarmed people within the space of a few days. However, the 80-year-old president announced on Truth Social on Wednesday that “we CANNOT give up one of I.C.E.’s most important and effective Crime Fighting tools, THE TRAFFIC STOP! Once we do, we are playing right into the criminal’s hands.” Read more at The Daily Beast.
